title: Global Resources PLC / Northern Mining Ltd: £1.8bn scheme
summary: Global Resources PLC makes a firm offer for Northern Mining Ltd at 620p per share, a 28.4% premium to the undisturbed price.

title: Acme Corp / Beta Ltd: A$2bn scheme
summary: Beta Ltd acquires Acme Corp via scheme at A$4.10 cash, a 31.2% premium to the undisturbed close.

title: TechCo Inc / Startup Labs: US$450m acquisition
summary: TechCo Inc acquires Startup Labs for US$450m in cash, a 24.7% premium to the 30-day VWAP.

title: BigBank Group: A$500m Tier 2 notes at 3M BBSW +185bps
summary: BigBank Group prices A$500m of 10NC5 Tier 2 notes at 3M BBSW +185bps, 15bps inside IPTs on 3x+ covered book.

title: FinCo Ltd: A$75m placement at $2.10
summary: FinCo Ltd raises A$75m via fully underwritten placement at a 7.5% discount to fund the acquisition of Regional Finance Partners.

title: Economy & Markets: 26 Oct 2026
summary: The Fed held at 5.25-5.50%; the RBA held at 4.35% with a mild tightening bias; markets price first cuts in 2027 for both central banks.
